tests.name: T1218.013 - Inject DLL into Target Process via Mavinject /INJECTRUNNING
tests.description: Simulates an adversary utilizing mavinject.exe to inject a dynamic-link library into a running process using the /INJECTRUNNING parameter.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Process Injection with Module Index Offset Parsing
tests.description: Simulates an adversary utilizing mavinject.exe to perform module allocation and injection passing module index offsets.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Proxy Execution via Mavinject /STARTAPP Virtual Package Trigger
tests.description: Simulates an adversary leveraging mavinject.exe /STARTAPP to launch an arbitrary executable under an App-V subsystem context.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Injection Using Alternate Environment Executable Path
tests.description: Simulates invoking mavinject.exe via explicit system environment variable string concatenation to execute process injection.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Process Injection from Staged Temporary Subdirectory
tests.description: Simulates staging a DLL inside a deeply nested temp directory before passing it to mavinject.exe for process injection.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Command Interpreter Subshell Invocation
tests.description: Simulates calling mavinject.exe through a cmd.exe subshell wrapper to evaluate command interpreter execution chains.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Sequential Dual-Process Mavinject Injection Trigger
tests.description: Simulates an adversary executing back-to-back mavinject.exe injections into two separate target processes.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Execution with App-V Environment Policy Switch
tests.description: Simulates an operator abusing mavinject.exe policy configuration switches to override App-V isolation boundaries.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Process Injection targeting App Container Host
tests.description: Simulates injecting a custom payload module into a running target process via mavinject.exe.

tests.name: T1218.013 - Mavinject Injection with NTFS Alternate Data Stream (ADS) Carrier
tests.description: Simulates an adversary passing a payload stored inside an NTFS Alternate Data Stream to mavinject.exe for process injection.
